name: x207 testnet circle (read-only)
description: Prototype of x207, a netting layer for x402 agent payments on NEAR (NEAR HACKATHON, 1-14 Nov 2026). This entry points at the read-only parts of a TESTNET demo: an MCP server with six read tools and a read API for the circle agents-main. Testnet only, mock USDT, no mainnet transaction. The listed endpoints do not charge and do not return 402; the x402 batch-settlement binding for NEAR is in the SDK, not behind these endpoints. Nobody but the team has used it.
